article.body:
القاهرة - مباشر: أعلنت شركة راية القابضة للاستثمارات المالية، توقيع شركة أمان القابضة -تابعة بنسبة 76%- مذكرة تفاهم غير ملزمة مع شركة جرير للتسويق "جرير
."
وأوضحت الشركة في إفصاح اليوم الخميس، أن مذكرة التفاهم تهدف إلى تأسيس شركة للتمويل الاستهلاكي في السعودية برأس مال مبدئي قدره 100 مليون ريال
.
وأضافت أن شركة أمان القابضة سوف تمتلك حصة قدرها 41%، فيما ستمتلك جرير للتسويق حصة 49%، وسيتم تخصيص الحصة المتبقية البالغة 10% لشركة حمد بن عبدالله بن سليمان المنيع وشركاه -شركة مساهمة سعودية مقفلة- أو مساهمين آخرين
.
يشار إلى أن راية القابضة للاستثمارات المالية، سجلت صافي ربح بلغ 1.27 مليار جنيه خلال الفترة من يناير حتى نهاية سبتمبر 2024، مقابل أرباح بقيمة 489.2 مليون جنيه خلال الفترة نفسها من العام الماضي، مع الأخذ في الاعتبار حقوق الأقلية
.
وارتفعت إيرادات الشركة خلال الفترة إلى 32.3 مليار جنيه، مقابل 22.6 مليار جنيه خلال الفترة نفسها من العام الماضي
.
وعلى صعيد القوائم غير المجمعة، تحولت الشركة المستقلة خلال الفترة إلى الخسائر لتتكبد 24.9 مليون جنيه، مقابل أرباح بلغت 56.6 مليون جنيه خلال النصف نفسه من 2023
.

=== REASONING GUARDRAILS ===
R1.  CITE WITH LOGIC. Do not cite a context field without a direct logical link
     to THIS news event. Generic citations ("90d corr = 0.77") are filler.
R2.  LOW VOL IS NOT BULLISH. Vol is about move size, not direction.
R3.  NEWS-TYPE CHECKLIST.
     capital_increase / m_and_a -> quantify dilution = new_shares / pre_existing
       (state both inputs). >5% dilution without preemptive rights = bearish prior.
     earnings   -> compare to consensus or recent trend.
     dividend   -> quantify yield = div / last_close (<2% small, 2-5% med, >5% large).
     regulatory -> approval positive; probe/fine negative.
     operational-> contract/win positive; halt/accident negative.
     macro      -> company impact often muted; lean on sector sensitivity.
R4.  TIMING. If the event happened BEFORE the article date, check the 1d return
     -- the market may have priced it in already.
R5.  PRICED-IN. Strong stock_vs_sector_1d alignment with the news direction
     means most SHORT impact is already in price; mid/long can still carry
     structural impact.
R6.  CONFIDENCE (per horizon): 0.8-1.0 clear+aligned; 0.5-0.7 mixed; 0.3-0.5
     ambiguous; 0.0-0.3 undetermined. Default conf_long <= conf_mid <=
     conf_short <= conf_intraday.
R7.  NO HALLUCINATION. State both inputs for any ratio (e.g. "917M / 4,529M = 20.3%").
R8.  PRICED-IN + INTRADAY/SHORT. If already_priced_in=true, INTRADAY and SHORT
     magnitudes default to "small" (and their direction may even oppose the news
     -- mean reversion). MID and LONG can still be sizable if the structural
     impact persists. Do NOT collapse all four horizons to "small" just because
     the news is priced in.
R9.  NO LANGUAGE LEAKS. Arabic free-text fields are 100% Arabic. No foreign
     words mid-sentence; use Arabic equivalents (اتجاه، تأثير غير مباشر، إلخ).
R10. SHAPE CONSISTENCY. Per-horizon outputs must match the declared expected_shape:
     pop_and_fade -> intraday/short magnitude >= mid >= long
     slow_burn    -> long magnitude  >= mid >= intraday/short
     persistent   -> direction identical across all four
     muted        -> all magnitudes "small"
     Contradiction = self-inconsistent answer.


=== TERM-STRUCTURE FRAMEWORK ===
Predict impact across FOUR independent horizons:
  intraday -> news day + next trading day  (neutral band +-1%)
  short    -> t+5  trading days            (neutral band +-2%)
  mid      -> t+20 trading days            (neutral band +-4%)
  long     -> t+50 trading days            (neutral band +-6%)

For EACH horizon, output: direction (up/down/neutral), magnitude (small/medium/large),
confidence in [0,1], 1-2 Arabic sentences of reasoning specific to THAT horizon.

MAGNITUDE bands (|cumulative AR|, %) -- scale with horizon:
              small       medium         large
  intraday:   <1%         1% to <3%      >=3%
  short:      <2%         2% to <5%      >=5%
  mid:        <4%         4% to <8%      >=8%
  long:       <6%         6% to <12%     >=12%

A 3% move is "large" intraday but "small" at t+50. Apply the right scale.
AR = stock return MINUS sector return (not raw price change).

CONFIDENCE typically decays with horizon (more unknowns accumulate).
Default: conf_long <= conf_mid <= conf_short <= conf_intraday. Flat-high
ladders need an explicit structural thesis (dilution, multi-year contract,
rule change).


=== SHAPE TEMPLATES (declare ONE in expected_shape) ===
pop_and_fade       intraday/short clear -> mid fades -> long neutral
                   (earnings, dividends, one-off prints)
slow_burn          intraday/short small/neutral -> mid clear -> long clear & growing
                   (M&A pending approval, capacity additions)
persistent         same direction across all four, similar or growing magnitude
                   (dilution, structural macro shifts, multi-year contracts)
cliff_and_recover  intraday/short sharp -> mid stabilizing -> long reverts toward neutral
                   (fines/probes that get resolved, panic selloffs)
muted              all four small or neutral
                   (routine disclosures, non-material news)
other              none of the above; explain explicitly in overall_reasoning

NEWS-TYPE PRIORS (override with evidence; if you override, name both shapes):
  earnings, dividend  -> pop_and_fade
  capital_increase    -> persistent or slow_burn (depends on dilution size)
  m_and_a             -> slow_burn
  regulatory          -> cliff_and_recover (fines) or persistent (rule changes)
  operational         -> any (one-off = pop_and_fade; structural = persistent)
  macro               -> persistent
  other               -> any


=== EXAMPLE (study the structure; do NOT copy verbatim) ===
Scenario: Capital increase, 200M new shares on a 1,000M base (20% dilution),
allocated to a third party, no preemptive rights. Stock dropped -3% today
(priced in). Downtrend (-8% over 20d, below MA-50). Vol low.

Good answer:
  news_type:          "capital_increase"
  expected_shape:     "persistent"
  already_priced_in:  true
  dilution_or_yield_note: "نسبة التخفيف = 200M / 1,000M = 20%"
  per_horizon.intraday: down / small / 0.60
     "السوق امتص الخبر اليوم (-3%). متبقٍ القليل خلال جلسة الغد."
  per_horizon.short:    down / small / 0.55
     "خلال الأسبوع، استمرار ضغط بيعي محدود بعد امتصاص الصدمة الأولى."
  per_horizon.mid:      down / medium / 0.65
     "خلال الشهر، السوق يستوعب التخفيف 20% بشكل أعمق."
  per_horizon.long:     down / medium / 0.55
     "الانخفاض الهيكلي مستمر، مع تخفيف محتمل من الأصول المستحوذ عليها."

Why this is right: R8 (priced-in -> intraday/short small), confidence decays
slightly, shape "persistent" matches downward direction across all four,
dilution quantified with both inputs.

Bad pattern: down/large/0.90 across all four horizons -- ignores priced-in
(R8), flat-high confidence with no structural reason, magnitudes not scaled
per horizon.


=== OUTPUT INSTRUCTIONS ===
1.  Read the Arabic article carefully. Do NOT translate.
2.  Classify news_type FIRST.
3.  Decide expected_shape using the SHAPE TEMPLATES + news-type prior. Override
    the prior if evidence demands it -- state the override explicitly in
    overall_reasoning.
4.  For EACH of intraday / short / mid / long, independently output direction,
    magnitude (using the horizon-specific bands), confidence, and a 1-2 sentence
    Arabic reasoning specific to that horizon.
5.  The per-horizon outputs MUST be consistent with the declared expected_shape (R10).
6.  Confidence ladder: default conf_long <= conf_mid <= conf_short <= conf_intraday
    unless structural thesis justifies otherwise (state it).
7.  If already_priced_in=true: intraday AND short magnitudes default to "small" (R8).
8.  overall_reasoning MUST cite >=3 specific context fields WITH LOGIC,
    name the news-type shape prior, and include the quantified ratio if applicable.
9.  LANGUAGE: All free-text in Arabic. JSON keys and enum values in English.
10. Output ONLY the JSON below. No markdown fences. No text outside.

{
  "news_type":         "capital_increase" | "m_and_a" | "earnings" | "dividend" | "regulatory" | "operational" | "macro" | "other",
  "expected_shape":    "pop_and_fade" | "slow_burn" | "persistent" | "cliff_and_recover" | "muted" | "other",
  "already_priced_in": <true | false>,
  "dilution_or_yield_note": "<Arabic ratio with inputs OR 'لا ينطبق'>",
  "key_drivers": ["<driver 1 Arabic>", "<driver 2 Arabic>"],
  "per_horizon": {
    "intraday": {
      "direction":  "up" | "down" | "neutral",
      "magnitude":  "small" | "medium" | "large",
      "confidence": <float 0.0-1.0>,
      "reasoning":  "<1-2 Arabic sentences specific to the intraday horizon (news day + next trading day)>"
    },
    "short": {
      "direction":  "up" | "down" | "neutral",
      "magnitude":  "small" | "medium" | "large",
      "confidence": <float 0.0-1.0>,
      "reasoning":  "<1-2 Arabic sentences specific to the short horizon (t+5 trading days)>"
    },
    "mid": {
      "direction":  "up" | "down" | "neutral",
      "magnitude":  "small" | "medium" | "large",
      "confidence": <float 0.0-1.0>,
      "reasoning":  "<1-2 Arabic sentences specific to the mid horizon (t+20 trading days)>"
    },
    "long": {
      "direction":  "up" | "down" | "neutral",
      "magnitude":  "small" | "medium" | "large",
      "confidence": <float 0.0-1.0>,
      "reasoning":  "<1-2 Arabic sentences specific to the long horizon (t+50 trading days)>"
    }
  },
  "overall_reasoning": "<3-5 Arabic sentences. MUST cite >=3 context fields with logic. MUST state the news-type shape prior and any override. MUST include the quantified ratio if applicable. MUST explain the term-structure shape choice.>"
}
